cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Access Has a Price
cards.instruction: Turn every piece of access, information, or approval into a favor, debt, or condition.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'll unlock the storeroom if you cover my reception break. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Someone spilled coffee in the lobby. Just tell me where the mop is.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Behind the buckets. That's five minutes of cover; unlocking costs another ten.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Lend me the key. I'll mop first, then cover your break.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The key costs tomorrow's break too. Today's cover pays for opening the door.
